translations.en: Walnoot is walnut, and Laurier is bay laurel.
So there are places or boxes with those names?
There might be.
In any case, let's investigate a little more.
All right, I'll leave it to you.
Oh, I haven't given you your reward yet. Thanks.
From @7rCarmine@0r, you received a reward of @3r45,000 G@0r and
@3rFairy Gloves@0r.
Once we've figured this out, I'll have another job for you.
From @7rCyrus@0r, you received @3r45,000 G@0r.
translations.note: Source explicitly identifies Cyrus as the reward-giver despite surrounding Carmine dialogue. Kept that source identity; may be a source inconsistency.

translations.en: Come on, quit dawdling! Let's go!
Ready to do it?
Since you've come to talk to me,
I'm expecting a yes!
"A house the lion gazes upon" is hardly a precise clue.
It is surprising that anyone would set out on so little.
translations.note: The omitted subject may refer to Carmine or the player's willingness to accompany her. This impersonal construction preserves the ambiguity; adjacent rows do not conclusively settle it.
translations.context: Independent event meaning reviews: events_middle reviewed first range, events_last reviewed middle range; parent verified source/context before accepting. Preserve source controls and per-row boundaries.

translations.en: Half exasperated, you nod and agree to accompany her.
Thanks!
We'll find that house the lion gazes upon,
and get the truth about @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r seal out of that monster!
The monster has "@7rLady@0r" in its name,
so I think it's probably female. A Vampire Queen
or something like that. You'd better be ready!
Hey, hold on.
Don't tell me you're backing out after we've come this far.
You'll ruin my plans!
I told you you're our main fighting force, didn't I?
What, have you suddenly got cold feet?
Anyway, we can't get anywhere without you.
I'll wait until you're available.
Just don't keep us waiting so long
that the city's seal is broken before we get started!
Hey, listen.
Apparently, when @7rChu Lu Gah@0r sealed off this city,
a certain monster helped him.
It seems the monster warned @7rChu Lu Gah@0r and made a pact with him.
And since it's a monster, it could still be alive.
Now, @6rDiemen@0r must have somewhere that @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
lived, or at least used as a hideout.
There has to be a place like that.
So I looked, but the only mention of @6rDiemen@0r
in @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r records was in
those papers we found the other day.
Apparently, this monster called @7rLady Marbas@0r
provided him with a hideout.
It says @7rMarbas@0r liked a house the lion gazes upon,
and made it her home.
So all we have to do is find that house!
Sorry to ask again,
but would you come along as my bodyguards?
@7rChu Lu Gah's@0r final hope was this @3rKey@0r.
What could that mean?
This... wasn't made by @7rChu Lu Gah@0r.
It's probably a key from an earlier age.
So it's the key to the ancient ruins?
So it was protected with a lock rather than a seal?
translations.context: Independent event meaning reviews: events_middle reviewed first range, events_last reviewed middle range; parent verified source/context before accepting. Preserve source controls and per-row boundaries.

translations.en: In that case, it seems we can't use this key yet.
It will be needed at the very end.
Then we must protect @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r seal ourselves.
Does that mean we have to defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r,
who are plotting to break it?
It does. Our first priority is to stop them.
Let's defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r.
We can take our time reinforcing the seal afterward.
I see...
I'm sorry I sent you on what seems to have been a wasted journey.
Here's your reward for this job.
From @7rBeatrix@0r, you received a reward of @3r150,000 G@0r.
Please use this reward to improve your equipment and so forth.
I'm sure the battle with @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r
will begin very soon...
@7rCarmine@0r, let's investigate this key!
Right. It's about the only thing
we can do now.
As @7rBeatrix@0r and the others hurry off to their research,
@7rAnselm@0r quietly whispers in your ear.
You must defeat them.
You are our last hope.
Do you understand? You must.
He must have wanted to make absolutely certain you understood.

context: Carmine explains the lion-house clue and Lady Marbas; the party concludes Gate Keeper and Key Master must be defeated.
